why_not_frozen: No development measurement has run against a real provider (JG-004 and JG-005 are open). Freezing settings on offline-scorer numbers would freeze a plumbing check, not retrieval quality.
freeze_rule: Tune only on benchmarks/manifests/development. Record frozen=true, a UTC timestamp and supporting run ids before held-out evaluation. That evaluation additionally requires a separate executor with verified isolation from questions and answers (JG-027/JG-029); the current runner refuses holdout and live modes.
open_questions: Batch width: 1, 8 and 16 items are to be compared once the provider layout decision (JG-005) exists.
Threshold: 0.5 is an experimental baseline, not a calibrated value; Noul scores are an uncalibrated retrieval signal.
Fragment size: the 800/1600-token target is untested against retrieval quality.
